title: gickup
description: Configuration for the gickup backup chart. In addition to the keys defined here, all values of the TrueCharts 'common' chart (service, workload, persistence, ...) are accepted - see https://truecharts.org/common/

schedule.description: Five-field Kubernetes cron schedule. Do not set `cron:` in conf.yml.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the schedule.

existingConfigMap.description: Existing ConfigMap in the release namespace with a conf.yml key. Takes precedence over configmap.config.data.conf.yml.

configmap.description: Common-chart ConfigMap definitions. Set config.data.conf.yml for an inline, token-free gickup config; the common chart renders it verbatim into <release>-config.
